collection.description: An eccentric elder claims the village's woven baskets are failing because of a pattern nobody else notices.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), an eccentric elder, claims the village's woven baskets are failing because of a pattern nobody else notices.

choices.label: Listen Without Assuming Genius or Foolishness

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (elder) correctly identifies a weak crossing technique.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Their unusual knot survives repeated use and surprises the apprentices.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their knot is impractical, but it inspires a better variation.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The two argue animatedly and then design a fair test.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (crafts) finds a simpler explanation, which (elder) accepts reluctantly.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) enjoys being taken seriously without automatic agreement.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder) reveals the whole theory began as a joke, embarrassing their devoted audience.

a2__fx.name: Outcome A2
a2__fx.text: The baskets hold up well, and (elder) cheerfully admits the theory was wrong.
